spans.s:
SIEGE: रोधः, अव-, नि-,
to raise a s.:
रोधं मुञ्चति or
sim. व्यपायाति (या, c. 2. = to go away), Mah.
iii. 19-26. Ph.:
to lay a s. to:
रुणद्धि (रुध्, c.
7.), Mah. iii. 15. 3.: v. To besiege.
SIESTA: दिवास्वप्नः and sim. comp. s: v. Sleep.

SIEVE:
I Subs.:
(1) चालनी;
(2) तितौ
(rarely n.).
II Verb.: v. To sift.
